location.description: Where to search: at least one of zip, county_fips, point, bbox or property_id. Send only one of point, bbox and property_id. You can combine that one with zip or county_fips.

items.description: Parcel segment: SFR, CONDO_TH (condo or townhouse) or OTHER, a mixed bucket of manufactured, multi-family, land and commercial parcels.

property_type_category.description: BatchData property type categories to keep, for example ["Residential"].

property_type_detail.description: BatchData property type details to keep.

vacant.description: True keeps parcels the USPS marks vacant. False keeps the rest.

mailing_address_vacant.description: True keeps parcels whose owner mailing address the delivery marks vacant.

beds.description: Bedrooms, as an inclusive min / max range.

baths.description: Bathrooms, as an inclusive min / max range.

stories.description: Stories, as an inclusive min / max range.

pool.description: True keeps parcels with a private pool.

garage.description: True keeps parcels with at least one garage space.

subdivision.description: Subdivision name contains this text, case-insensitive.

owner.description: The current owner: the facts, and the portfolio filters from the Owner Profile block.

kind.description: Owner kinds to keep.

items.description: Kind of the owner at the deed data end: PERSON, TRUST, ENTITY or PUBLIC_INSTITUTIONAL (a public body).

owner_occupied.description: True keeps owner-occupied parcels. False keeps the rest.

is_public.description: True keeps public-body owners. False excludes them. The default excludes nothing.

mailing_state.description: Owner mailing states to keep, 2 letters each.

out_of_state.description: True keeps owners whose mailing state differs from the parcel's state.

portfolio_count.description: Properties the owner holds (Owner Profile block).

portfolio_equity.description: The owner's total estimated equity, dollars.

sale.description: The last sale as the deed feed summarises it.

price_per_sqft.description: Last sale price per living square foot.

document_type.description: Deed types to keep, as the feed writes them.

cash_sale.description: True keeps last sales with a price and no recorded purchase mortgage (the cash_sale_proxy flag). The API answers 422 cash_sale_unavailable when a market of the location does not measure it (meta.coverage[].parcel.sale_mortgage_measured false).

market_value.description: The assessor's total market value, dollars.

delinquent.description: True keeps parcels with a delinquent tax year on the roll.

exemptions.description: Keep parcels carrying any of these exemptions.

listing.description: The newest MLS record the listing feed carries.

status.description: Feed statuses to keep, for example ["Active", "Pending"].

listed_since.description: Original listing date on or after this date.

sold_since.description: Sold date on or after this date.

is_rental.description: True keeps rental listings. False keeps sale listings.

financing.description: The open liens and the last recorded mortgage (dated).

open_lien_count.description: Open liens at the slice date (dated).

lender_name_contains.description: The last recorded mortgage's lender name contains this text, case-insensitive (dated).

lender_id.description: The last recorded mortgage's lender is this registry lender: a len_ id from /v1/lenders (dated). The API matches on the id that every spelling of the lender folds to. So a renamed or truncated spelling is the same filter. The API answers 400 when no market of the location has a lender registry (meta.coverage[].lenders null).

lender_class.description: Lender classes of the last recorded mortgage to keep (dated).

items.description: How the lender name reads. BANK: a bank, credit union or thrift. NONBANK: a mortgage company or other lending business. PRIVATE: a trust, a seller carry-back or another private party, not the hard-money sense of private lender, which the Lender object carries as is_hard_money. INDIVIDUAL: a person's name. GOVERNMENT: an agency or a public body.

has_heloc.description: True keeps parcels with an open HELOC (dated).

free_and_clear.description: True keeps parcels with zero open liens (dated).

last_mortgage_since.description: The recording date of the last recorded mortgage is on or after this date (dated).

interest_rate.description: The senior open lien's estimated rate, percent (dated).

involuntary.description: True keeps parcels with an involuntary lien on record (dated).

since.description: The issue date of the newest permit is on or after this date.

count_24m.description: Permits issued in the 24 months before the permit snapshot date (the permit block's as_of).

tags.description: Keep parcels with a permit that carries any of these tags, for example ["Solar", "Pool and Hot Tub"]. The API reads only the permits of the 24 months before the permit snapshot date (as_of).

open.description: True keeps parcels with a permit active or in review for more than 12 months at the permit snapshot date (as_of). False keeps parcels with none. False leaves out a parcel whose jurisdiction has unmeasured permit windows (coverage windows_measured false).

major_work_36m.description: True keeps parcels with a major-work permit in the 36 months before the permit snapshot date (as_of). False keeps parcels with none. False leaves out a parcel whose jurisdiction has unmeasured permit windows (coverage windows_measured false).

job_value_24m.description: Declared job value over the 24 months before the permit snapshot date (as_of), dollars.

history.description: The history summary (history ZIP set only).

owner_changes_3y.description: Owner changes in the 3 years before the data end (history ZIP set only).

last_owner_change.description: The week of the last owner change.

listing_cycles_1y.description: Listings started in the year before the data end (history ZIP set only).

price_cuts_current_listing.description: Price cuts since the current listing started.

became_vacant_since.description: The parcel became vacant in this week or later and is still vacant at the data end.

delinquent_since.description: The parcel went tax delinquent in this week or later and is still delinquent at the data end.

filters.description: The filter groups. Every group and every field is optional. The API combines the groups with AND.

items.description: A quicklist name, for example absentee-owner, free-and-clear, price-cut-listing, tired-landlord. The quicklists guide documents the list and every predicate. The API answers 400 quicklist_unavailable to an unavailable name.

any_quicklists.description: At least one listed quicklist must match (OR).

items.description: A quicklist name, for example absentee-owner, free-and-clear, price-cut-listing, tired-landlord. The quicklists guide documents the list and every predicate. The API answers 400 quicklist_unavailable to an unavailable name.

not_quicklists.description: Keep parcels that match none of the listed quicklists.

items.description: A quicklist name, for example absentee-owner, free-and-clear, price-cut-listing, tired-landlord. The quicklists guide documents the list and every predicate. The API answers 400 quicklist_unavailable to an unavailable name.

datasets.description: Which blocks each row carries: core, owner, owner_profile, sale, tax, listing, valuation, financing, permits, history, quicklists. Default: core, owner, sale, tax, listing. The valuation and financing blocks are dated (meta.dated[]). The API answers 400 dataset_unavailable to an unavailable name.

items.description: Which blocks each row carries: core, owner, owner_profile, sale, tax, listing, valuation, financing, permits, history, quicklists. Default: core, owner, sale, tax, listing. The valuation and financing blocks are dated (meta.dated[]). The API answers 400 dataset_unavailable to an unavailable name.

require_current.description: With true, the API answers 422 dated_refused when the request filters on, sorts by or returns a dated block (valuation, financing, liens). Default false: the API serves dated blocks and stamps them in meta.dated[].

sort.description: Row order, null values last on every sort. distance: nearest first, the default with a point or a property_id. The sort id orders rows by market then id, the primary key order: stable and fast over any location, the default otherwise. The sorts last_sale_date_desc and last_sale_date_asc order by the last sale date, listing_price_asc and listing_price_desc by the list price. The sort last_owner_change_desc puts the history ZIP set first and the others last. The sorts equity_percent_desc, equity_percent_asc and avm_desc are dated (meta.dated[]). The sorts year_built_desc, year_built_asc, sqft_desc and last_permit_desc order by year built, the living area and the newest permit.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from page.next_cursor of the previous page. A change of query, sort, weights or data version invalidates it (400 invalid_cursor). Then restart from page 1.

count_only.description: True returns the count of matching parcels in summary.total and no rows.

first_week.description: The first week the history lake observed the parcel. Null when the lake never observed the parcel.

last_week.description: The last week the history lake recorded an event. Null when the lake recorded no event.

n_events.description: Events on record. Null when the build has nothing to compute it from.

owner_changes_3y.description: Owner changes in the 3 years before the data end. Null when the build has nothing to compute it from.

last_owner_change.description: The week of the last owner change. Null when the lake recorded no owner change.

listing_cycles_1y.description: Listings started in the year before the data end. Null when the build has nothing to compute it from.

price_cuts_current_listing.description: Price cuts since the current listing started. Null when the build has nothing to compute it from.

last_delist.description: The week of the last delisting. Null when the lake recorded no delisting.

vacant_since.description: The week the parcel became vacant, when it is still vacant at the data end. Null otherwise.

delinquent_since.description: The week taxes went delinquent, when they are still delinquent at the data end. Null otherwise.

last_new_mortgage.description: The week of the last new mortgage (dated window). Null when the window carries no new mortgage.

id.description: Parcel id, the key to every other property route.

market.description: The market the parcel belongs to.

distance_miles.description: Miles from the point or the property_id centre. Null without one.

owner.description: Null when you did not request the owner dataset.

sale.description: Null when you did not request the sale dataset.

tax.description: Null when you did not request the tax dataset.

listing.description: Null when you did not request the listing dataset, or the parcel carries no MLS record.

valuation.description: Dated. Null when you did not request it, or the slice carries no AVM for the parcel.

financing.description: Dated. Null when you did not request it, or the slice carries no row for the parcel.

permits.description: Null when you did not request it, or the parcel carries no permit.

history.description: Null when you did not request it, or the parcel is outside the history lake's ZIP set.

quicklists.description: Every quicklist the parcel matches, when you requested the quicklists dataset. Null otherwise.

total.description: The count of matching parcels when count_only is true. Null on a paged request (page the rows instead).

dated_filters.description: The filter groups, quicklists and sorts of this request that read dated columns. Empty when none do.

ParcelSearchSummary.description: What the request asked for and, on count_only, how many parcels match.

investor.description: Who the buyer is and what they do across the market, with member_names[] for the name join.

score.description: Fit for the subject, 0 to 1, best first, rounded to 4 decimals: base_score x activity_multiplier. With the default w_activity=0 the multiplier is 1 and score equals base_score, gate x the weighted mean of the factor values in reasons[]. Compare within one response only. A different subject, radius, weight set or w_activity is a different scale.

gate.description: 1 when the investor bought in the last 3 years before the data end date. 0.5 otherwise, which includes an investor that never bought. The API multiplies the score by it, so a dormant investor never outranks an active one with the same factors.

base_score.description: The score before the activity signal, 0 to 1, rounded to 4 decimals: gate x sum(weight x value) over reasons[]. The weights sum to 1.

activity_multiplier.description: What the activity signal did to the score, 0.01 to 1, rounded to 4 decimals: buyer_signal.activity_p_180 raised to the power w_activity. When that probability is null, the API uses the dormant rate the w_activity parameter documents. 1 with the default w_activity=0. The formula is score = base_score x activity_multiplier.

reasons.description: One entry per factor the API can score, in plan order: proximity, recency, price_fit, strategy, segment, wholesale_buyer, resale_fit. A factor without its input is absent, and the API redistributes its weight. Such an input is an asking price, a condition or priced purchases. The activity signal is not a factor and has no entry. Show detail to the user as it is.

sample_deals.description: Up to 5 of their deals inside the geometry. Nearest first, or newest first when the request has no reference point. They are the proof shown under the row. id opens `/v1/deals/{id}`.

buyer_signal.description: The operator this investor belongs to (investor.operator_id), its capital cycle and its probability of buying in the next 180 days after the data end. Served to every key. Null for a market without a built buyer signal, and when the investor has no signal row.

listings.description: What the investor has on the market right now, measured at listings_data_end: their holdings listed ACTIVE or PENDING in the MLS feed. Not a factor of the score. Served to every key. Null for a market without published listing tables. Zeros when the market has them and nothing is listed.

wholesale_purchases.description: What the investor bought off Investorlift listings per the recorded deeds: counts by window, the last one and the companies they buy from. Not a factor of the score. Served to every key. Null for a market without published wholesale tables. Zeros when the market has them and the investor never bought one.

str.description: How many holdings of the investor carry a business-use short-term-rental licence attributed to them, from the rolls of the cities. Not a factor of the score. Served to every key. Null for a market without published short-term rental tables. Zeros when the market has them and the investor holds no such parcel.

BuyerMatch.description: One ranked buyer for the subject property.

state.description: 2-letter state of the mailing address of the buyer, when known. Null otherwise.

n_events.description: Their deal rows inside the geometry after the filters (usually 1).

last_bought_on.description: Their last purchase inside the geometry, YYYY-MM-DD. Null when none was a purchase.

nearest_distance_miles.description: Miles from the reference point to their nearest deal here, rounded to 2 decimals. Null without a reference point.

buyer_status.description: Here only unclassified, a named buyer that is not an investor, or excluded with include_excluded=true. The buyer's standing in the registry: registered (has an investor id), unclassified, excluded or unknown (the deed names no buyer). Unclassified: a named buyer the registry did not classify as an investor, usually a household. Excluded: a named buyer the registry deliberately left out. Those are custodian trusts, relocation companies, auction houses and ambiguous surnames.

anyOf.description: Why an excluded buyer has no investor id. INSTITUTION: a custodian, a relocation company or an auction house. AMBIGUOUS_NAME: a bare surname. POOLED_NAME: a name that many unrelated people share.

buyer_exclusion.description: Null for unclassified buyers. Why an excluded buyer has no investor id. INSTITUTION: a custodian, a relocation company or an auction house. AMBIGUOUS_NAME: a bare surname. POOLED_NAME: a name that many unrelated people share.

score.description: Proximity and recency only, best first, rounded to 4 decimals. The scale is 0 to 1, the same as data[].base_score with the other weights set to 0. The weight w_activity does not apply to the unregistered tail: nothing here has a buyer signal.

UnregisteredBuyer.description: An id-less buyer inside the geometry: a household or an unclassified name that bought here. A lead, not a ranked investor.

registered.description: Deal rows inside the geometry after the filters whose buyer carries an investor id.

unclassified.description: Rows whose buyer has a name but no investor classification (usually a household).

excluded.description: Rows whose buyer the registry deliberately left out: custodian trusts, relocation companies, auction houses and ambiguous surnames.

unknown.description: Rows with no named buyer on the deed.

by_buyer_status.description: Deal rows inside the geometry after the shared filters, by buyer status. Buyers without an investor id count here too, but the API does not rank them.

n_investors_ranked.description: Investors with an id that passed the filters and got a score: the total the pages walk. Paged lists carry no total.

n_unpriced.description: Deal rows inside the geometry with no price on the deed.

n_undated.description: Deal rows inside the geometry with no purchase date.

unregistered.description: Only with include_unregistered=true: the id-less buyers inside the geometry, best first, at most 200. Excluded groups need include_excluded=true.

MatchSummary.description: Counts for the whole geometry, not only the page, plus the unregistered tail when you ask for it.

key.description: The item's key at the dataset's grain: a 5-digit county FIPS, an upper-case jurisdiction or permit issuer name, or a 5-digit ZIP. A blank issuer is the empty string.

name.description: The county name for a county item; null for a jurisdiction or a ZIP.

status.description: The item's own status. Served: the API publishes the dataset for the whole market, or for every item of its scope it can serve. Partial: the API serves at least one item of the scope and not every item it can serve. Not_measured: the build ran and the delivery cannot measure the fact. No build fixes it, so do not wait. Not_published: the tables are absent or unbuilt for the market. A later build fixes it, so wait. Not_applicable: a scope item the API can never serve, for example a city with no licence requirement. It is never the status of a whole dataset.

gate.description: The error code a data call meets for this item alone. A county outside the lender registry reads outside_coverage. A ZIP outside the lake reads history_unavailable. Null where the API serves the item. Also null for an unserved short-term rental jurisdiction, because the filters answer an empty page there, not an error.

as_of.description: The item's own date: a county's last deed date, a jurisdiction's snapshot date, or a permit issuer's newest issue date. Null where nothing is loaded.

reason.description: For a short-term rental jurisdiction, its coverage_reason: LOADED_SERVED, LOADED_UNVALIDATED, LOADED_COUNTS_ONLY, REQUIRED_NOT_PUBLISHED, NO_REQUIREMENT or NOT_SURVEYED. Null elsewhere.

regime.description: For a short-term rental jurisdiction, if it requires a licence: REQUIRED, NOT_REQUIRED or UNKNOWN. Null elsewhere.

feed_stale.description: For a short-term rental jurisdiction, true when this week's feed failed its freshness rule and the API serves the last good snapshot. Null elsewhere.

licence_start.description: For a short-term rental jurisdiction, the earliest date a licence can exist there. Null elsewhere, and null when unknown.

counts.description: The counts the source row records for the item. A jurisdiction carries n_licensed, n_pending, n_expired and n_advertised. A permit issuer carries n_permits. Null for a county and for a ZIP. A count itself is null where the jurisdiction is not loaded, because a missing measurement is not a zero.

CoverageScopeItem.description: One item of a dataset's scope, at the grain of the dataset: a county, a city-limit jurisdiction, a permit issuer or a ZIP. Each item carries its own status, gate and date.

status.description: The dataset's status for the market. Served: the API publishes the dataset for the whole market, or for every item of its scope it can serve. Partial: the API serves at least one item of the scope and not every item it can serve. Not_measured: the build ran and the delivery cannot measure the fact. No build fixes it, so do not wait. Not_published: the tables are absent or unbuilt for the market. A later build fixes it, so wait. Not_applicable: a scope item the API can never serve, for example a city with no licence requirement. It is never the status of a whole dataset.

dated.description: True when the dataset is a snapshot valued at as_of and every response that carries a value from it stamps meta.dated[]. The financing slice is dated, and so is the lender registry built from it. Independent of status: a dataset can be partial and dated at once. A dated set never refreshes. With require_current it answers 422 dated_refused.

stale.description: True when the as-of date failed its freshness rule against the clock of the request. Deeds follow the 45-day rule, and short-term rentals the weekly feed rule of a served jurisdiction. Null where no rule exists: listings, agents, wholesale, parcels and lenders. A dated set never refreshes, and a stale one is late.

as_of.description: The dataset's date, one per dataset. Deeds carry the last deed date, listings the end of the listing feed, and wholesale the Investorlift export date. Short-term rentals carry the snapshot date, parcels the deed end of the layer, and financing the slice date. Permits carry the snapshot date, owner_profile the delivery date, history the last week of the lake, and lenders the slice date. Null where the API does not publish the dataset. Also null for the auction counts, which carry no date of their own.

gate.description: For not_published and not_measured, the error code a data call meets when it needs the dataset. The codes are listings_unavailable, agents_unavailable, wholesale_unavailable, auction_unavailable, str_unavailable, parcels_unavailable, history_unavailable, cash_sale_unavailable, lenders_unavailable and addresses_unavailable. Null for served and partial. Each scope item then carries its own code.

granularity.description: The grain of the dataset. Deeds and lenders are decided at county grain. Short-term rentals and permits are decided at jurisdiction grain. The history lake is decided at zip grain. Every other dataset is decided at market grain.

kind.description: counties, jurisdictions or zips.

items.description: Every item, served or not.

scope.description: The list of items at the grain of the dataset, with a status per item. Deeds lists the counties of the market with their deed ends. Lenders lists every county of the market and the registry's cover. Short-term rentals lists every jurisdiction, permits every issuer, and history every ZIP the lake covers. Null for a market-grain dataset, and null where the API publishes nothing.

features.description: Lenders only: the per-market *_measured flags of the registry: purchase_measured, investor_lending_measured, flips_measured, borrowers_measured, takebacks_measured and counties_measured. They are features of one dataset, not statuses. Null elsewhere.

place_status.description: Present only when you gave a place: what this place gets from this dataset at the grain of the dataset. served or outside. Null when the input cannot decide the grain. A bare point decides neither the lender registry nor a jurisdiction. A ZIP and a county decide no jurisdiction.

DatasetCoverage.description: One dataset of one market: its status, its dated and stale flags and its as-of date. It also carries the error a call meets where the API does not serve it, and its scope.

market.description: Market code; the loaded markets are in meta.coverage[].

state.description: 2-letter state of the market. The loaded markets and their states are in meta.coverage[].

label.description: The display name of the market, for example "Phoenix metro". The county names and the state where none is set.

stage.description: general, or beta while the pricing pages label the market so.

anyOf.description: The area every count in this market covers: metro, county or zip. A metro market covers whole counties. A county market covers one county. The market cannot see what an investor did in the neighbouring counties. A zip market covers one or more ZIP codes. The market cannot see what an investor did outside them, a larger gap. In a county or zip market every investor count, price band, scale tier and confidence is a floor.

universe_kind.description: Null when the market row does not record it. The area every count in this market covers: metro, county or zip. A metro market covers whole counties. A county market covers one county. The market cannot see what an investor did in the neighbouring counties. A zip market covers one or more ZIP codes. The market cannot see what an investor did outside them, a larger gap. In a county or zip market every investor count, price band, scale tier and confidence is a floor.

items.description: A 5-digit ZIP.

universe_zips.description: The ZIP codes of a zip universe; null for county and metro markets.

fips.description: The 5-digit county FIPS code, for example 04013.

name.description: County name, for example Maricopa.

data_end.description: The last deed date on file for this county, YYYY-MM-DD. Null when the county carries no dated deed.

items.description: One county the loaded area lies in.

counties.description: The counties the loaded area lies in, each with its own last deed date.

bbox.description: The rectangle (west, south, east, north) that encloses every deal in the market.

point_tolerance_miles.description: How far outside bbox a point can lie and still get an answer, in miles.

n_parcels.description: Parcels in the loaded area. Null when the coverage row does not record it.

data_end.description: The last deed date in the market, YYYY-MM-DD.

dataset_version.description: Version of the loaded data for this market. It is the same value meta.coverage[].dataset_version carries.

loaded_at.description: When this data version went live, ISO 8601.

stale.description: True when data_end is more than 45 days before the time of the request.

datasets.description: The matrix row of this market: one cell per dataset key, in the order of the keys.

CoverageMarket.description: One loaded market with its coverage matrix: the area, the version, the freshness, and one cell per dataset with its status there.

kind.description: The lookup that ran: point (lat and lng), county, zip or market.

value.description: The value the API resolved: "lat,lng", the county as you gave it, the ZIP, or the market code.

input.description: The place that was asked about.

status.description: covered when at least one loaded market admits the place. outside when none does. Never a 422: this route answers the question the data routes refuse.

markets.description: The market codes that cover the place, in load order. [] when outside.

name.description: County name.

counties.description: The counties the input resolved to, by ascending FIPS. A county name that two served states share gives one county per state, so read the FIPS, not the first row. A ZIP input gives every county the ZIP touches, largest land share first, through the public ZIP-to-county crosswalk. Null for a point or a market code.

CoveragePlace.description: The place lookup: the place you asked about, if a loaded market covers it, which markets, and the counties it resolved to.

market.description: The code the market will load under.

state.description: 2-letter state of the market. The loaded markets and their states are in meta.coverage[].

name.description: County name.

counties.description: The counties the build intends to load.

items.description: A dataset a market can lack. The keys are deeds, listings, agents, wholesale, auction, str, parcels, financing, permits, owner_profile, history, cash_sale, lenders and addresses. Deeds carries the deals, the investors and the registry, and listings the MLS listings. Agents carries the listing agents, wholesale the Investorlift listings, and auction the foreclosure-auction and REO counts. Str carries the short-term rental rolls, and parcels the parcel layer and the property search. Financing carries the dated financing, lien and valuation slice, and history the weekly history lake. Cash_sale carries the cash-sale proxy, lenders the lender registry, and addresses the lookup by street address.

datasets.description: The datasets the build intends to serve.

status.description: planned: decided, not started. building: the chain runs on a build database, and the production publish is a separate step.

since.description: The day the row was listed, YYYY-MM-DD.

target.description: A quarter such as 2027-Q1 when one is decided; null otherwise.

label_kind.description: Always "intent": a planned row is intent, not a commitment. The Developer Agreement promises no refresh cadence and no continuity, and the list can change without notice.

note.description: One sentence of context, or null.

PlannedMarket.description: A market Investorlift intends to serve and this host does not serve yet, as labelled intent. It leaves this list the day its tables are published, and appears in markets[] instead.

markets.description: Every loaded market with its matrix. With a place, only the markets that cover it, and [] when none does.

place.description: The place lookup that ran. Null when you gave no place.

planned.description: The markets Investorlift intends to serve and this host does not serve yet, as labelled intent. A code this host has loaded is never listed here.

CoverageData.description: Which data is available where: the coverage matrix of every loaded market, the place lookup when you asked one, and the planned markets.

res.description: The H3 resolution the cells are at: 7 or 8, as requested.

cells.description: H3 cell ids as hex strings, for example "8829a1d0e5fffff", in cell-id order. Every array below has one entry per cell at the same position.

n.description: Deals in the cell after the filters.

n_wholesales.description: Of those, wholesales. A wholesale is a resale in under 30 days, or a chain resale or a round trip within 90 days.

n_holds.description: Of those, parcels an investor still holds.

n_long_holds.description: Of those, held over a year and then resold.

n_other.description: Of those, other investor resales. Examples: a loss, a thin margin, a builder's new home resold, an iBuyer resale.

n_builds.description: Of those, builds: lots or teardowns a registered investor bought, built on, then sold, under the bounds of the build kind. A market built on or before 2026-09-17 (meta.coverage[].loaded_at) counts every lot-to-build resale by a registered investor as a build until its next build.

n_investors.description: Distinct registered investors behind the deals in the cell. The count leaves out buyers without an investor id.

DealCells.description: Deal counts per H3 cell as parallel arrays: the zoomed-out map layer.

year.description: Four-digit purchase year, for example 2024. Null for the bucket of deals with no purchase date. That bucket comes last.

n.description: Deals bought that year after the filters.

hold.description: Of those, parcels an investor still holds.

long_hold.description: Of those, held over a year and then resold.

build.description: Of those, builds, under the bounds of the build kind. A market built on or before 2026-09-17 (meta.coverage[].loaded_at) counts every lot-to-build resale by a registered investor as a build until its next build.

SummaryYear.description: Deals bought in one year, by kind.

n_deals.description: Deal rows inside the geometry after the filters.

flip.description: Flips: bought, fixed and resold within about a year.

wholesale.description: Wholesales: resold in under 30 days, or a chain resale or round trip within 90.

hold.description: Holds: bought and held at the deed data end.

long_hold.description: Long holds: held over a year, then sold.

other.description: Other investor resales: not a clean flip.

build.description: Builds: lots or teardowns a registered investor bought, built on, then sold, under the bounds of the build kind. A market built on or before 2026-09-17 (meta.coverage[].loaded_at) counts every lot-to-build resale by a registered investor as a build until its next build.

n_investors.description: Distinct registered investors behind those rows.

n_parcels.description: Distinct parcels: a parcel with several deals counts once.

n_unpriced.description: Rows with no price on the deed.

median_bought_price.description: Median purchase price over priced rows, whole dollars. Null when no row carries a price.

median_sold_price.description: Median resale price over priced resold rows, whole dollars. Null when no resold row carries a price.

total_volume.description: Sum of purchase prices over priced rows, whole dollars. Null when no row carries a price.

median_hold_days.description: Median days from purchase to resale over resold rows. Null when no row is resold.

median_gross_profit.description: Median sold minus bought over resold rows, whole dollars. Null when no resold row carries both prices.

by_year.description: Deals per purchase year and kind, oldest year first. Undated deals form one bucket with year null at the end. The buckets sum to n_deals.

anyOf.description: Investor scale: individual (one person, no entity), small (fewer than 10 investment deals), mid (10 to 99), large (100 to 999) or institutional. An institutional investor is an iBuyer, a production builder, a bulk landlord with 500 or more holdings, or a known brand from a list. The registry counts the deals inside the area loaded for the market (meta.coverage[].universe_kind), so in a ZIP market the tier is a floor.

scale.description: Investor scale tier. Null for buyers without an investor id. Investor scale: individual (one person, no entity), small (fewer than 10 investment deals), mid (10 to 99), large (100 to 999) or institutional. An institutional investor is an iBuyer, a production builder, a bulk landlord with 500 or more holdings, or a known brand from a list. The registry counts the deals inside the area loaded for the market (meta.coverage[].universe_kind), so in a ZIP market the tier is a floor.

n.description: Deals whose buyer is in this tier.

items.description: One scale tier.

by_scale.description: Rows per investor scale tier, individual first. Buyers without an investor id form a scale: null bucket last. The buckets sum to n_deals.

anyOf.description: Investor kind, the primary one of kinds[] (an investor can carry several), for display only. FLIPPER: buys, renovates and resells. WHOLESALER: buys to resell quickly, often through a double close. LANDLORD: buys and holds rentals. BUILDER: builds on lots it buys. IBUYER: Opendoor, Offerpad or Zillow.

kind.description: Investor kind. Null for buyers without an investor id. Investor kind, the primary one of kinds[] (an investor can carry several), for display only. FLIPPER: buys, renovates and resells. WHOLESALER: buys to resell quickly, often through a double close. LANDLORD: buys and holds rentals. BUILDER: builds on lots it buys. IBUYER: Opendoor, Offerpad or Zillow.

n.description: Deals whose buyer carries this kind.

items.description: One investor kind.

by_investor_kind.description: Rows per investor kind, largest first. Buyers without an investor id form a kind: null bucket. A deal counts under every kind its investor carries, so the buckets overlap and do not sum to n_deals.

DealSummaryStats.description: Headline numbers for the geometry after the filters, with the per-year breakdown by kind.

n_investors_ranked.description: Investors with an id that passed the filters. This is the total the pages walk. A paged list carries no other total.

n_unpriced.description: Deal rows inside the geometry with no price on the deed.

n_undated.description: Deal rows inside the geometry with no purchase date.

InvestorListSummary.description: Totals over the geometry after the shared filters, the same on every page.

id.description: Parcel id, prop_ followed by 32 hex characters: pass it to `/v1/properties/{property_id}` or as property_id geometry.

market.description: Market code the parcel belongs to, for example phx. The loaded markets are in meta.coverage[].

apn.description: Assessor parcel number as recorded, for example "131-28-253". Null when the county did not supply one.

apn_norm.description: APN with punctuation removed, upper case, for example "13128253": the lookup key for /v1/properties/resolve. Null when apn is null.

county_fips.description: County FIPS, 5 digits, for example 04013 Maricopa, 04021 Pinal or 48201 Harris. Null when the parcel table carries none.

address_short.description: Situs street address in title case including the unit, for example "7522 E Cholla St". Null when the parcel has no situs address.

street_no_unit.description: The street address without the unit. Null when the parcel has no situs address.

unit.description: Unit designation, for example "UNIT 8". Null for most parcels.

city.description: City, upper case. Null when the parcel has no situs address.

state.description: 2-letter state, for example AZ. The build takes the market's state when the parcel has no situs address.

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP. Null when the parcel table carries none.

latitude.description: WGS84 latitude of the centre of the parcel. Null when the parcel has no coordinates.

longitude.description: WGS84 longitude of the centre of the parcel. Null when the parcel has no coordinates.

anyOf.description: Parcel segment: SFR, CONDO_TH (condo or townhouse) or OTHER, a mixed bucket of manufactured, multi-family, land and commercial parcels.

segment.description: Parcel segment: SFR, CONDO_TH (condo or townhouse) or OTHER (manufactured, multi-family, land, commercial). Null when the assessor use code is unknown.

bedrooms.description: Bedrooms per the assessor. Null when the assessor did not report them.

bathrooms.description: Bathrooms per the assessor. The value can be fractional, for example 2.5. Null when the assessor did not report them.

sqft.description: Living area in square feet. Null when the assessor did not report it.

year_built.description: Year built. Null when the assessor did not report it.

pool.description: True for a private pool, false for community pool or spa only, null when the assessor did not report it (most parcels).

pool_type.description: Pool detail as the assessor wrote it, for example `Pool - Yes`. Null when the assessor did not report it (most parcels).

Parcel.description: One parcel: its id, county, APN, situs address, coordinates and the assessor facts used as subject-property defaults.

date.description: Date of the most recent purchase deed on the parcel, YYYY-MM-DD. Null when the API finds no arm's-length deed.

price.description: Price on that deed, whole dollars. Null when the deed carries no price (non-disclosure states such as Texas).

LastPurchase.description: The most recent purchase deed on the parcel, whoever the buyer was.

anyOf.description: Kind of the owner at the deed data end: PERSON, TRUST, ENTITY or PUBLIC_INSTITUTIONAL (a public body).

kind.description: Null when the county roll does not say. Kind of the owner at the deed data end: PERSON, TRUST, ENTITY or PUBLIC_INSTITUTIONAL (a public body).

owner_occupied.description: True when the owner's mailing address is the parcel itself. Null when the county roll does not say.

absentee.description: True when the owner's mailing address is elsewhere. Null when the county roll does not say.

is_trust.description: True when the owner is a trust. Null when unknown.

is_public.description: True when the owner is a public body, for example a city, the state or a school district. Null when unknown.

anyOf.description: How the owner holds the parcel at the deed data end (meta.coverage[].data_end), read from the county owner roll behind the row. OWNER_OCCUPIED means the owner lives there, ABSENTEE_INDIVIDUAL a person whose mailing address is elsewhere, and ABSENTEE_ENTITY an LLC or trust. RENTAL_REGISTERED means the parcel is on the county rental registry. RENTAL_SIGNAL means an owner-attributed business-use short-term-rental licence in any market. In Texas it also means an absentee owner with no homestead exemption or a rental listing. The short_term_rental block says which. UNKNOWN means the county roll does not say.

holding_kind.description: Null when unknown. How the owner holds the parcel at the deed data end (meta.coverage[].data_end), read from the county owner roll behind the row. OWNER_OCCUPIED means the owner lives there, ABSENTEE_INDIVIDUAL a person whose mailing address is elsewhere, and ABSENTEE_ENTITY an LLC or trust. RENTAL_REGISTERED means the parcel is on the county rental registry. RENTAL_SIGNAL means an owner-attributed business-use short-term-rental licence in any market. In Texas it also means an absentee owner with no homestead exemption or a rental listing. The short_term_rental block says which. UNKNOWN means the county roll does not say.

anyOf.description: How the owner at the deed data end got the parcel. PURCHASE (an arm's-length deed, priced where the state records prices). TRANSFER (an unpriced deed between related parties). NO_DEED: no deed found. UNMATCHED: a deed exists but its buyer name does not match the owner.

acquisition_kind.description: Null when unknown. How the owner at the deed data end got the parcel. PURCHASE (an arm's-length deed, priced where the state records prices). TRANSFER (an unpriced deed between related parties). NO_DEED: no deed found. UNMATCHED: a deed exists but its buyer name does not match the owner.

held_since.description: When the current ownership started, YYYY-MM-DD. Null when no dated source exists.

months_held.description: Months since held_since, measured at the data end date, for example 44.4. Null without held_since.

rental_registered.description: True when the parcel is on the county rental registry. Null when unknown.

permits_last_24m.description: Building permits filed on the parcel in the 24 months before the data end date. Null when the build has nothing to count them from.

permits_reno_last_24m.description: Renovation permits (remodel, addition, roof, pool) in the same 24 months. A subset of permits_last_24m. Null when permits_last_24m is null.

name_order.description: Always given_first for owner names. The word order of the raw name. A deed name is surname_first, for example "RIVERA DANA". A parsed owner name is given_first, for example "Dana Rivera". The order is unknown for one token, a truncated name, "&" or ET AL: the split fields are then null.

anyOf.description: Why names and mailing are null: not_an_investor_hold or public. With not_an_investor_hold, the parcel is not a confirmed investor holding and not a business-use short-term rental with a dated or named basis. The API then treats the owner as a household and never names them. With public, the owner is a public body.

redacted_reason.description: Null on a confirmed investor holding or an attributed business-use short-term rental. This host still does not name the holder. Otherwise, why this host does not name the holder: not_an_investor_hold or public. With not_an_investor_hold, the parcel is not a confirmed investor holding and not a business-use short-term rental with a dated or named basis. The API then treats the owner as a household and never names them. With public, the owner is a public body.

PropertyOwner.description: The current owner of the parcel. The API always serves the facts (kind, owner_occupied, absentee, holding_kind, permits). It serves the identity (names, mailing) only on two kinds of parcel. One is a confirmed investor holding. The other is a business-use short-term rental attributed to the owner by a date or a name.

id.description: Parcel id, prop_ followed by 32 hex characters: pass it to `/v1/properties/{property_id}` or as property_id geometry.

market.description: Market code the parcel belongs to, for example phx. The loaded markets are in meta.coverage[].

apn.description: Assessor parcel number as recorded, for example "131-28-253". Null when the county did not supply one.

apn_norm.description: APN with punctuation removed, upper case, for example "13128253": the lookup key for /v1/properties/resolve. Null when apn is null.

county_fips.description: County FIPS, 5 digits, for example 04013 Maricopa, 04021 Pinal or 48201 Harris. Null when the parcel table carries none.

address_short.description: Situs street address in title case including the unit, for example "7522 E Cholla St". Null when the parcel has no situs address.

street_no_unit.description: The street address without the unit. Null when the parcel has no situs address.

unit.description: Unit designation, for example "UNIT 8". Null for most parcels.

city.description: City, upper case. Null when the parcel has no situs address.

state.description: 2-letter state, for example AZ. The build takes the market's state when the parcel has no situs address.

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP. Null when the parcel table carries none.

latitude.description: WGS84 latitude of the centre of the parcel. Null when the parcel has no coordinates.

longitude.description: WGS84 longitude of the centre of the parcel. Null when the parcel has no coordinates.

anyOf.description: Parcel segment: SFR, CONDO_TH (condo or townhouse) or OTHER, a mixed bucket of manufactured, multi-family, land and commercial parcels.

segment.description: Parcel segment: SFR, CONDO_TH (condo or townhouse) or OTHER (manufactured, multi-family, land, commercial). Null when the assessor use code is unknown.

bedrooms.description: Bedrooms per the assessor. Null when the assessor did not report them.

bathrooms.description: Bathrooms per the assessor. The value can be fractional, for example 2.5. Null when the assessor did not report them.

sqft.description: Living area in square feet. Null when the assessor did not report it.

year_built.description: Year built. Null when the assessor did not report it.

pool.description: True for a private pool, false for community pool or spa only, null when the assessor did not report it (most parcels).

pool_type.description: Pool detail as the assessor wrote it, for example `Pool - Yes`. Null when the assessor did not report it (most parcels).

owner.description: Who holds the parcel at the deed data end date (meta.coverage[].data_end) and how. This host never names the holder.

listing.description: The MLS listing on the parcel: the latest listing the feed knows, its status, prices and agent. Its owner_test says if it belongs to the parcel's current holder, and is null when no investor holds the parcel. Its list_to_bought_ratio is null here. Null when the parcel carries no listing record, and when the market has no published listing tables (meta.coverage[].listings_data_end is null then). This host does not name the agents.

short_term_rental.description: The short-term rental licence facts of the parcel from the city's own roll. The block says if the parcel is licensed and since when. It says if the licence belongs to the current owner and on what basis, and if the use is a business. Served to every key. Present on every parcel inside a loaded city: status NONE when it has no record, status null where coverage.served is false. Null outside every loaded city (meta.coverage[].str.jurisdictions says why), and when the market has no published short-term rental tables (meta.coverage[].str_as_of is null then).

deals.description: Every deal on the parcel: every kind and every year, public-body investors included, because a parcel lookup is not a list. Newest purchase first, undated deals last.

wholesale_listings.description: Every Investorlift listing of the house, newest first, each with the listing company and what the deeds show occurred. The API does not attach a hidden-address listing without a closing deed to the parcel, so it does not appear. Empty when the house was never listed. Null when the wholesale tables are not published (meta.coverage[].wholesale_as_of is null then). Served to every key.

Property.description: One parcel with its owner facts, its short-term rental licence, its deal history and its Investorlift listings.

id.description: Parcel id of this row.

apn.description: APN as recorded on this row, for example "101-08-158B". Two rows can differ only in punctuation. Null when the county did not supply one.

county_fips.description: 5-digit county FIPS, for example 04013 Maricopa, 04021 Pinal or 48201 Harris. Null when the parcel table carries none.

city.description: City, upper case. Null when the parcel has no situs address.

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP. Null when the parcel table carries none.

unit.description: Unit designator as the county records it on this row, for example "# 2007", "UNIT 5C" or "B": the same value as the parcel block's unit. Null on a single-unit parcel. Pass it as unit= to pick this row from an ambiguous_address. The bare value, "2007", does as well.

latitude.description: WGS84 latitude of the centre of this row's parcel. Null without coordinates.

longitude.description: WGS84 longitude of the centre of this row's parcel. Null without coordinates.

n_deals.description: Deals recorded on this row. The row with the most deals wins when twins are the same parcel.

same_parcel.description: True when this row is a spelling twin of the resolved property (same county, within 100 m): use the resolved property_id and ignore this row. False on an ambiguous_apn or ambiguous_address error, where the rows are different parcels.

ResolveCandidate.description: Another parcel row matching the APN or the address.

anyOf.description: Parcel id: prop_ followed by 32 hex characters, for example prop_e93c776c53354a88de4e58448a6bf21b. The prefix is part of the id.

property_id.description: The resolved parcel id to pass as property_id to every other endpoint. Null only on an error.

property.description: The resolved parcel block. Null only on an error.

candidates.description: Spelling twins of the resolved parcel (same_parcel: true). Empty for a point lookup, a unique APN and a unique address.

ResolveResult.description: The parcel behind a point, an APN or an address.

property_id.description: Parcel id: prop_ followed by 32 hex characters, for example prop_e93c776c53354a88de4e58448a6bf21b. The prefix is part of the id.

market.description: The market the subject and every comp belong to.

address_short.description: Situs street line as the delivery formats it. Null when the delivery does not record it.

city.description: City, upper case. Null when the delivery does not record it.

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP. Null when the delivery does not record it.

bedrooms.description: Bedrooms. Null when unknown, and then the API does not apply the bedroom tolerance.

bathrooms.description: Bathrooms. Null when the delivery does not record it.

sqft.description: The living area in square feet. Null when unknown, and then the API does not apply the size tolerance and price_per_sqft_value is null.

year_built.description: Year built. Null when unknown, and then the API does not apply the year tolerance.

sold_on.description: The date of the subject's own arm's-length last purchase.

sold_price.description: Whole US dollars. Null when the price is unknown, for example a deed that carries no price. Non-disclosure states record no price on most off-market deeds.

last_sale.description: The subject's own last purchase from the deed registry, for the reader's reference. It is never one of the comps. Null when the registry records none.

CompSubject.description: The parcel the API measures the comps against, with the facts the tolerances read.

id.description: The deal id, for the deal lookup route.

kind.description: What occurred on the deal. flip: bought, fixed and resold within about a year at a profit-shaped margin; wholesale: bought and resold in under 30 days, or a chain resale or round trip within 90 (a double close); hold: bought and still owned at data_end, a confirmed holding or an un-resold purchase; long_hold: held over a year, then sold (a landlord exit); other: an investor resale that is not a clean flip. Reasons: a loss, a thin margin, a builder's new home resold, an iBuyer resale, or a chain resale of 3 to 12 months; build: a registered investor bought a lot or teardown, built a house on it during the hold, then sold. A builder's finished home bought and resold is other. On data built after 2026-09-17 the kind keeps only a single-family parcel held over 90 days, its house complete by the sale year. A market built on or before 2026-09-17 (meta.coverage[].loaded_at) counts every lot-to-build resale by a registered investor as a build until its next build.

anyOf.description: Investor id: inv_ followed by 12 hex characters, for example inv_abaf618f44a3. The id is stable across data refreshes within a market. Store it as the investor's identity.

investor_id.description: The exiting investor's id. Null when the registry keeps no profile for it.

gross_profit.description: Resale price minus purchase price on a paired deal, whole dollars. Null on an unpaired deal, or where a price is null.

hold_days.description: Days between the deal's purchase and its recorded resale. Null where a date is null.

CompDeal.description: The investor exit this sale was, when the deal registry records an exit on the parcel within 45 days of the sale date. The API takes the nearest exit. The window covers an MLS close that precedes its recording. The block shows the rehab economics a plain comp cannot show.

property_id.description: Parcel id: prop_ followed by 32 hex characters, for example prop_e93c776c53354a88de4e58448a6bf21b. The prefix is part of the id.

market.description: The comp's market (the subject's).

address_short.description: Situs street line as the delivery formats it. Null when the delivery does not record it.

city.description: City, upper case. Null when the delivery does not record it.

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP. Null when the delivery does not record it.

distance_miles.description: Distance from the subject parcel in miles, two decimals.

sold_on.description: The sale date: the deed's recording date on a DEED comp, the close date on an MLS comp.

sold_price.description: The sale price, whole dollars. A comp always carries one, because unpriced sales are not comps.

price_per_sqft.description: sold_price over the parcel's living area, two decimals, in US dollars per square foot. Null when the sqft is unknown.

bedrooms.description: Bedrooms. Null when the delivery does not record it.

bathrooms.description: Bathrooms. Null when the delivery does not record it.

sqft.description: The living area in square feet. Null when the delivery does not record it.

year_built.description: Year built. Null when the delivery does not record it.

source.description: DEED: the parcel's arm's-length last purchase from the deed registry. MLS: a SOLD listing record. A parcel keeps its newest sale. An MLS record wins over a deed recorded within 45 days of it.

days_on_market.description: Days on market of the MLS record. Null on a DEED comp.

list_price.description: The last list price of the MLS record, in whole US dollars. Null on a DEED comp, or when the feed carries none.

cash_sale_proxy.description: True when the sale carried a price and no purchase mortgage is on record for it. The API reads it from the parcel layer where the market has one and the layer's last sale is this one (45 days). Null where the layer is absent, the sale is not the layer's last sale, or the market does not measure the proxy. That last case is meta.coverage[].parcel.sale_mortgage_measured false.

last_sale_lender.description: The lender of the purchase mortgage recorded on the sale, read the same way. Null where none is on record, or the layer is absent.

deal.description: The investor exit this sale was, or null when the deal registry records no exit on the parcel within 45 days of the sale date.

similarity.description: How close the comp is to the subject, 0 to 1, three decimals: one minus a weighted sum of five ratios. The first three: the distance over the radius (0.35), the size gap over the size tolerance (0.25), the bedroom gap over its tolerance (0.15). The last two: the age gap over its tolerance (0.10), and the sale's age over the window (0.15). A tolerance the subject cannot apply contributes nothing. The API orders the comps by it.

Comp.description: One comparable sale: the parcel, the sale, the source, the parcel-layer facts where served, the investor exit where recorded, and the similarity.

n.description: Comps returned (at most limit).

median_price.description: Median sold_price over the comps returned, in US dollars. Null when n is 0.

median_price_per_sqft.description: Median price_per_sqft over the comps that carry one, in US dollars per square foot. Null when none does.

price_per_sqft_value.description: median_price_per_sqft times the subject's sqft, rounded to whole dollars. An indication, not a valuation: the API makes no time or condition adjustment. Null when either is unknown.

min_price.description: The lowest sold_price returned, in US dollars. Null when n is 0.

max_price.description: The highest sold_price returned, in US dollars. Null when n is 0.

radius_miles.description: The radius the API drew the comps from.

window_start.description: The first sale date in the window (the market's data_end minus days_back).

window_end.description: The last sale date in the window: the market's data_end.

items.description: DEED: the parcel's arm's-length last purchase from the deed registry. MLS: a SOLD listing record. A parcel keeps its newest sale. An MLS record wins over a deed recorded within 45 days of it.

sources.description: The sources the API read: DEED, MLS, or both. MLS is absent when the market has no listing tables (meta.coverage[].listings_data_end null) and source was both.

bedrooms.description: The bedroom tolerance applied. Null when the subject's bedrooms are unknown.

sqft_pct.description: The size tolerance applied, percent. Null when the subject's sqft is unknown.

year_built.description: The year tolerance applied. Null when the subject's year_built is unknown.

tolerances.description: Which tolerances the query applied: a fact the subject lacks cannot bound the comps.

CompsSummary.description: The comps in aggregate, over the comps returned: counts, the medians, the range, the window and the tolerances applied.

Comps.description: `GET /v1/properties/{id}/comps`: the subject, its comparable sales within the radius, the window and the tolerances, and the summary.

distance_miles.description: Miles from the reference point. Null when no reference point exists.

investor_id.description: The current registry holder. This ID does not prove who offered an older listing.

n_listings.description: Publicly linked listings on this parcel at any time. Hidden parcel links never count.

anyOf.description: Investorlift listing id: wl_ followed by 32 hex characters, for example wl_9f2c1d0e8b7a6c5d4e3f2a1b0c9d8e7f. The id is stable per Investorlift listing and the same in every market. It is the key to GET `/v1/wholesale-listings/{id}`. The prefix is part of the id.

newest_listing_id.description: ID of the newest public listing. Null when the count is zero.

investorlift.description: Public Investorlift listings on this parcel. Null when the market lacks wholesale coverage.

n_with_sold_price.description: Matching sold listings with a positive closing price.

n_with_price_history.description: Matching listings that carry an asking price and the highest asking price of the listing.

n_price_cut.description: Matching listings whose asking price is below the highest asking price of the listing. Divide by n_with_price_history for the share with a price cut.

n_investor_held.description: Matching listings whose ownership test is PASSED.

n_on_investorlift.description: Matching parcels with public Investorlift listings. Null unless every selected market has wholesale coverage.

as_of.description: Common source date when all selected markets share it. Null when their dates differ.

listings_data_end.description: Listing source date for this market.

as_of_by_market.description: Source dates for every selected market, including markets with no matching rows.

p25.description: Continuous 25th percentile in whole US dollars. Null below the sample floor.

p75.description: Continuous 75th percentile in whole US dollars. Null below the sample floor.

rent.description: Usable asking rents from SFR and CONDO_TH rows. Whole US dollars per month.

rent_per_sqft.description: Usable rent ratios from SFR and CONDO_TH with positive area. US dollars per square foot per month, two decimals.

listings_data_end.description: Listing source date for this market.

id.description: Stable cycle ID from the property listing history. One property can have several cycles.

market.description: Market code.

property.description: Current served assessor facts. These facts are not a reconstruction at the sale date.

distance_miles.description: Miles from the reference point. Null without a reference point.

listed_on.description: Original listing date observed for this cycle. Null when absent.

sold_on.description: Closing date observed for this sold cycle. Null when absent.

sold_price.description: Positive closing price observed for this sold cycle, in whole US dollars. Null when absent or nonpositive.

last_list_price.description: Last positive asking price observed for this cycle, in whole US dollars. Null when absent.

days_on_market.description: Days from the listing date to the closing date. Null without valid dates in that order.

first_observed_on.description: First observation week of this cycle.

last_observed_on.description: Last observation week of this cycle.

dataset_version.description: Every loaded market with its version, one market=version pair per market, joined by commas, for example "phx=1788469819" for one market. The value of the X-Dataset-Version header on every response, and the string to add to a cache key. Null when the API has no loaded market.

data_end.description: The latest last deed date across the loaded markets, YYYY-MM-DD. Each market has its own in markets[]. Null when the API has no loaded market.

market.description: The market code, for example phx.

state.description: 2-letter state of the market. The loaded markets and their states are in meta.coverage[].

dataset_version.description: The version of the loaded data for this market. It changes only on a rebuild of the market's tables. Every response carries the same value in meta.coverage[].dataset_version.

data_end.description: The last deed date in the market, YYYY-MM-DD.

fips.description: The 5-digit county FIPS code, for example 04013.

name.description: County name, for example Maricopa.

data_end.description: The last deed date on file for this county, YYYY-MM-DD. Null when the county carries no dated deed.

items.description: One county the loaded area lies in.

counties.description: The counties the loaded area lies in, each with its own last deed date.

loaded_at.description: When this data version went live, ISO 8601.

items.description: One loaded market and how fresh it is.

markets.description: The loaded markets, one row each.

Dataset.description: The loaded data: the dataset version and the last deed date of every market, and the one-line version label every response repeats.

id.description: The investor that holds the parcel: the key to GET `/v1/investors/{id}`, and the buyer on the parcel's hold row in GET /v1/deals.

items.description: Investor kind, the primary one of kinds[] (an investor can carry several), for display only. FLIPPER: buys, renovates and resells. WHOLESALER: buys to resell quickly, often through a double close. LANDLORD: buys and holds rentals. BUILDER: builds on lots it buys. IBUYER: Opendoor, Offerpad or Zillow.

kinds.description: Every kind the investor qualifies for, for example ["LANDLORD"]. An empty list when the registry assigned none.

anyOf.description: How sure the registry is of the kind. STRONG: several deals of that kind and a consistent pattern. PROBABLE: some evidence. WEAK: a single signal. The registry judges the confidence from the deeds inside the area loaded for the market (meta.coverage[].universe_kind). In a ZIP market an investor's deals outside the ZIP are unseen, so the confidence is a floor.

confidence.description: The registry's confidence in the investor's primary kind. Null when the registry assigned none.

StrParcelInvestor.description: The registered investor that holds the parcel, when one exists. Open GET `/v1/investors/{id}` for the name and the str roll-up.

property.description: The parcel: its id (the key to GET `/v1/properties/{property_id}`), address, coordinates and assessor facts.

distance_miles.description: Miles from the reference point, rounded to 2 decimals. The reference point is lat + lng, or the centre of the property_id parcel. Null when the request had no reference point.

short_term_rental.description: The parcel's licence facts. Never null here, because every listed parcel carries a record.

owner.description: Who holds the parcel and how. This host never names the holder. redacted_reason says why the internal tier does not name them either: a prior owner's permit, a person's own home and an ASSUMED attribution keep redacted_reason not_an_investor_hold.

investor.description: The registered investor that holds the parcel. Null when no registered investor holds it. You then reach the owner through owner.names and owner.mailing under the identity rule.

StrParcelRow.description: One parcel with a short-term rental record inside the geometry. The row carries the parcel, its licence facts, its owner under the identity rule and the investor that holds it, if any.

ETag.description: The entity tag of the answer, derived from the dataset version of the markets in the response and from the representation, not from the body. It moves only when a refresh rebuilds the tables of a market. On a JSON route, send it back as If-None-Match, and an unchanged dataset answers 304 with no body. The API streams an export whatever the tag. GET /v1/dataset runs no query, so it is the lowest-cost place to send the tag. On every 2xx and the 304, never on an error.

Retry-After.description: Whole seconds to wait before you retry, never below 1. On a 429, the seconds until the spent bucket refills. On a 503, 1 for pool_saturated and 5 for ledger_unavailable, and none for database_unavailable. On a 403 plan_limit for the name-search day cap, the seconds to the next UTC midnight, when the cap resets. The other plan limits carry none. The body repeats it as retry_after on the 429, the ledger refusal and the day cap.

X-Request-Id.description: The id of this call. The edge mints it and also sends it as zp-rid, the gateway's own name for it. The API keys its log line for the call on it, and every error body repeats it as request_id. Log it on every response, not only on errors. A refusal the gateway answers itself carries zp-rid and request_id alone. Those refusals are a 401, a 403 quota_exceeded and a 429 at the limit of the plan.

X-Rows.description: How many rows the body carries: data.length on a list, 1 on a single record. The size of the body, not a charge. Absent on a streamed export, whose count the API knows only when the stream ends, and on a 304.

X-Dataset-Version.description: The dataset version of every market in the response, as market=version pairs joined by commas (phx=1788469819 for one market). The header carries one pair per loaded market. The figures are the same as meta.coverage[].dataset_version, and you can read them without parsing the body. A version moves only when a refresh rebuilds the tables of the market, so fold the label into cache keys. On every 2xx and the 304, never on an error. Absent when the answer names no market: an empty deployment, or a GET /v1/coverage lookup outside every market.

X-Data-End.description: The last deed date of every market in the response, as market=YYYY-MM-DD pairs joined by commas (phx=2026-08-12 for one market). The header carries one pair per loaded market. The dates are the same as meta.coverage[].data_end. On every 2xx and the 304, never on an error. Absent when the answer names no market: an empty deployment, or a GET /v1/coverage lookup outside every market.

X-Row-Cap.description: The most rows an export streams, 50,000. The API counts the filtered set before the first row. It refuses a larger set as 422 csv_cap_exceeded, with cap and n_rows_at_least in the body. On every export answer and on that refusal.

X-Credits-Charged.description: The origin sets this header: the credits this response cost. It is 0 when the account already unlocked every record on it. The plans page of the documentation site says what counts.

X-Credits-Remaining.description: The edge sets this header: the credits left in the billing period after this response, recent to within a minute. It is negative on a plan with overage, down to its ceiling. Absent on Enterprise.

type.description: A URI reference that identifies the problem.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem.

tags.name: buyers
tags.description: Which investors are the best fit for this house: the API ranks nearby investors against a subject property and explains each score.

tags.name: deals
tags.description: What occurred around a location: deals for a table, cells for a map, summary stats, and one deal by id.

tags.name: investors
tags.description: Who the buyers are: investors active in an area, a full profile, and their metro-wide history. A search finds an investor by any name they buy under.

tags.name: properties
tags.description: One parcel: find it from a point or an APN, then read its facts, owner information, short-term rental licence and every deal on it. The owner information covers investor holdings and business-use short-term rentals.

tags.name: agents
tags.description: Who the listing agents are: find one by name or licence number, then read the profile and every listing of theirs. The profile holds the licence, the brokerages, the listing counts and the investors they belong to.

tags.name: wholesale
tags.description: Investorlift listings as wholesale transactions: the houses listed, and what the county deeds show for each (closed, to whom, which deed). Also the listing companies, and what each investor bought off Investorlift.

tags.name: lenders
tags.description: Who lends on houses in a market: find a lender by any spelling of its name. Rank the lenders of a market, or of one ZIP, city or county. Read a profile: loans counted once across the open-lien and recorded-history tables, the open book, terms, geography and rankings. List every loan of one lender.

tags.name: dataset
tags.description: What the API serves, how fresh it is and which data is available where. The dataset version and the last deed date of every market, for cache keys and freshness checks. The coverage matrix, with a place lookup.

tags.name: contract
tags.description: Routes sold per jurisdiction under an order form and not reachable on a self-serve key. Ask through the console.
